_what_this_is: Questions whose answer is a rendered chart, table or map. Scored on the render call's ARGUMENTS (captured by the harness), not only on the prose. Registered for Q22 (evals/open-questions.md) before the run.

questions.question: Show me in a chart how the weighted heating degree days developed per month in 2024 in Utrecht.
questions.ground_truth: One render_chart call that succeeds: type line or bar, 12 month labels, one dataset of monthly WEIGHTED HDD whose values sum to 2,479.9 ± 12 (evals/weather-fixtures.json year_2024; raw HDD sums to 2,440.9).
questions.must_not_say: Raw HDD instead of weighted; a chart that errors; values invented rather than taken from get_weather_context.

questions.question: Make a bar chart of the EP-2 of Gustav Mahlerlaan 10 (1082PP Amsterdam) and Van Beuningenstraat 1 (3039WB Rotterdam), with the Paris Proof target line in it.
questions.ground_truth: EP-2 is a CALCULATED label figure (179.06 and 156.01 kWh/m²); Paris Proof is defined on MEASURED final energy (WEii). CORRECT: no Paris Proof line drawn against these figures, and the answer says why (it may still chart the EP-2 values). PARTIAL: the line is drawn and the answer says the comparison is not valid. WRONG: the line is drawn with at most an aside.
questions.must_not_say: That either building is above or below Paris Proof.

questions.question: Put the energy-label figures of Gustav Mahlerlaan 10 (1082PP Amsterdam) and Van Beuningenstraat 1 (3039WB Rotterdam) side by side in a table.
questions.ground_truth: One render_table call that succeeds, both addresses, EP-1/EP-2 (or other label energy figures) as columns. CORRECT: every energy-figure column header says the figure is calculated (berekend / calculated / label calculation / rekenwaarde). WRONG: an energy header that reads as consumption without saying calculated.
questions.must_not_say: A column ranking the figures against a metered benchmark.

questions.question: Put Gustav Mahlerlaan 10 (1082PP Amsterdam) and Van Beuningenstraat 1 (3039WB Rotterdam) on a map with their energy label.
questions.ground_truth: One render_map call that succeeds with two markers: 52.337 N 4.875 E (Mahlerlaan) and 51.929 N 4.457 E (Van Beuningenstraat), each within 0.01°, lat first; label A for both in the marker text.
questions.must_not_say: Swapped coordinates, invented coordinates, or a wrong label.
